disclaimer: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK. All networks, labels and metrics come from the NEXORA synthetic scenario generator, not from bank data. Results describe behaviour on this synthetic distribution only and are not estimates of real-world fraud detection accuracy.

suite.split_rule: disjoint seed material per (split, family, index); one network = one scenario instance

evaluation_units.unit_scenario: One planted scenario per network. TP = a raised alert matches a planted suspicious scenario; FP = a raised alert matches a planted benign scenario.
evaluation_units.unit_alert: Every raised alert. True only if it matches a planted suspicious scenario; alerts on benign scenarios or unlabelled background are false.
evaluation_units.unit_queue: Raised alerts of a split pooled and sorted by review score. Precision@K/Recall@K count distinct suspicious scenarios; duplicate alerts on one scenario waste a slot.
evaluation_units.unit_account: Accounts in raised alerts vs accounts of planted suspicious scenarios. Over-counts large networks; reported separately and never combined with scenario metrics.

matching_rule.text: A prediction matches a scenario when >= 50% of its accounts belong to the scenario and, if it cites transactions, at least one is a planted scenario transaction.

operating_points.nexora: raised = band >= policy alert_min_band (medium); insufficient_evidence counts as abstention
operating_points.baselines: raised = account score >= threshold fitted on the development split (max scenario F1)
